feature: Three favorite series in both balance modes
new_game_plus: Native favorite union is preserved; three distinct choices per setup.

bonus_exp.english: Their characters gain 1.5x EXP in battle,

bonus_upgrades.english: and their units get +2 to every upgrade limit.

controls.english: Confirm: pick/remove    Cancel: undo last pick

reset.assembly:
addiu $sp,$sp,-16
        sd $ra,0($sp)
        jal 0x1660d0
        nop
        li $v0,8204224
        sw $zero,0($v0)
        sw $zero,4($v0)
        sw $zero,8($v0)
        sw $zero,12($v0)
        sw $zero,16($v0)
        ld $ra,0($sp)
        jr $ra
        addiu $sp,$sp,16

choose.assembly:
addiu $sp,$sp,-32
        sd $ra,0($sp)
        jal 0x1661e0
        move $a0,$s0
        li $t8,8204224

        lw $a0,0x3ac($s0)

        beqz $a2,stay
        nop
        sll $a2,$a1,2
        addu $a2,$a2,$t8
        sw $a0,8($a2)
        addiu $a1,$a1,1
        or $v1,$v1,$t9
        sw $a1,4($t8)
        sw $v1,0($t8)
        addiu $a2,$zero,3
        bne $a1,$a2,stay
        nop
        ld $ra,0($sp)
        addiu $sp,$sp,32
        lw $s1,0x134($s0)
        bnez $s1,complete
        nop
        j 0x165ba0
        nop
    complete:
        j 0x165b84
        nop
    remove:
        nor $t9,$t9,$zero
        and $v1,$v1,$t9
        sw $v1,0($t8)
        move $a2,$zero
    find:
        sll $a3,$a2,2
        addu $a3,$a3,$t8
        lw $v0,8($a3)
        beq $v0,$a0,compact
        nop
        addiu $a2,$a2,1
        sltu $v0,$a2,$a1
        bnez $v0,find
        nop
        b stay
        nop
    compact:
        addiu $a1,$a1,-1
        sw $a1,4($t8)
    shift:
        sltu $v0,$a2,$a1
        beqz $v0,clear
        nop
        lw $v0,12($a3)
        sw $v0,8($a3)
        addiu $a2,$a2,1
        b shift
        addiu $a3,$a3,4
    clear:
        sw $zero,8($a3)
    stay:
        ld $ra,0($sp)
        addiu $sp,$sp,32
        j 0x165ba0
        nop

undo.assembly:
li $t8,8204224
        lw $v0,4($t8)
        beqz $v0,exit_menu
        nop
        addiu $sp,$sp,-32
        sd $ra,0($sp)
        addiu $v0,$v0,-1
        sw $v0,4($t8)
        sll $v1,$v0,2
        addu $v1,$v1,$t8
        lw $v0,8($v1)
        sw $zero,8($v1)
        lw $a1,0x3ac($s0)
        sw $a1,8($sp)
        sw $v0,0x3ac($s0)
        jal 0x1661e0
        move $a0,$s0
        lw $a1,8($sp)
        sw $a1,0x3ac($s0)
        li $t8,8204224
        addiu $v1,$zero,1
        sllv $v1,$v1,$v0
        nor $v1,$v1,$zero
        lw $v0,0($t8)
        and $v0,$v0,$v1
        sw $v0,0($t8)
        ld $ra,0($sp)
        addiu $sp,$sp,32
        lui $a0,0x3d
        j 0x165be0
        nop
    exit_menu:
        lw $a2,0x138($s0)
        lui $a0,0x3d
        bnez $a2,exit_event
        nop
        j 0x165be0
        nop
    exit_event:
        j 0x165bcc
        nop

commit.assembly:
li $v0,8204224
        lw $v1,4($v0)
        addiu $a2,$zero,3
        bne $v1,$a2,done
        nop
        lw $v0,0($v0)
        lw $v1,0x5e8($a0)
        or $v0,$v0,$v1
        sw $v0,0x5e8($a0)
    done:
        jr $ra
        nop

native_bonuses: Original EXP and upgrade-limit checks read all chosen bits without replacement.
